story_type: fishing boat slamming through Bering Sea waves, helicopter medevac seen from the air
hook: Waves broke over this boat. Then a man aboard needed a hospital.
narration: Bering Sea waves were exploding over this fishing boat, and one man aboard needed a hospital.
The Bountiful was forty-six miles southwest of Saint Paul Island, Alaska, in late January.
A Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Kodiak flew out to meet her through the whitecaps.
In seas like this, the pilot holds a hover while the deck heaves up and down under the cable.
outcome: The Kodiak crew hoisted the 43-year-old aboard and flew him to Saint Paul, on his way to Anchorage.

location_card.place: Bering Sea, near Saint Paul Island, Alaska

title: Bering Sea waves bury a fishing boat
description:
On Jan. 28, 2020, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak hoisted a 43-year-old man off the fishing vessel Bountiful, 46 miles southwest of Saint Paul, Alaska.
